# Exit

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Loops](Language-Features-Loops)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Exit
```

## Description

Leaves the closest loop ([For](For), [While](While) or [Repeat](Repeat)) and continues after it.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
For i = 1 To 10
	If i = 3 Then Exit
	Print i
Next
Print "done"
```

```text
1
2
done
```

[For](For), [Forever](Forever)
